title: Faculty Introduction
prompt:
Hanneman approaches Byleth with eager scholarly curiosity while Manuela interrupts or redirects him with practiced confidence. Byleth remains calm between them. Keep the rhythm lighter than the church scenes but still grounded.

Camera: medium three-shot, slight handheld warmth.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: slapstick, exaggerated flirting, modern comedy. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
